semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Foresight Technology specializes in AI-powered smart manufacturing solutions, which can be applied to semiconductor manufacturing processes but does not directly supply semiconductor materials or equipment.
summary: Foresight Technology Company, Ltd. provides AI-driven smart manufacturing solutions, focusing on Automatic Virtual Metrology and a unified AIoT platform called Foresight NexusAI. Their offerings enable enterprises to deploy and manage AI applications across various operations, enhancing efficiency and decision-making.
